witness.explanation: The collision-merging proof needs the allowed alphabet to be closed under local multiplication and uses a compatible uniform cost. Unit weights alone do not provide group closure.
witness.evidence: At one CNOT location allow X_c and X_t but not X_cX_t. A multiset containing X_c and X_t has size two and realizes the combined effect X_cX_t. A legal configuration, which permits only one allowed assignment at that location, cannot realize that product there. Thus multiset and occupied-location optima need not agree for an incomplete alphabet. In the full Pauli-group unit-cost model, merging does prove equality; the witness concerns extending the statement beyond that model, not refuting the full-model lemma.
